message:
Now let me understand the fuzz harness. Let me check what the target harness is - it's likely the OpenEXR fuzzer. Let me look at the build environment and find the fuzz target:

<function=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>find /workspace/_work -name "*fuzz*" -o -name "*oss*" | head -30 && echo "---" && find /workspace/_work/build-asan-internal -name "*.a" -o -name "exrcheck" | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜ode>
